fact: M-PESA Ethiopia had 3.4 million 90-day active users and 30,700 merchants in November 2025, with EthSwitch integration allowing QR merchant payments and interoperability with connected banks; Telebirr had over 54.8 million users in 2024/25.
title: M-PESA Ethiopia Reaches 3.4mln Users as Transactions Total 12.3bln birr
